anim-api-models.caption: One subscription, many models: /model lists what the connected target offers and switches the session without leaving the conversation.
anim-api-models.source: PanCode 0.9.1 installed with npm install -g, recorded with asciinema v2 in a terminal pane (scenario anim-api-models, hand-driven) in a scratch profile: home /home/researcher, host lab, 100x30 terminal, idle capped at 1s. Environment: PANCODE_REDUCE_MOTION=1. Settings: interface: { mode: fullscreen, outputDetail: compact }. One target is configured: copilot (runtime copilot-sdk) with gpt-6-luna, signed in to GitHub Copilot. No message is sent; the take only switches the session model.
